environment.hardware: Apple M4 Pro (Mac16,7-class) — 14 cores, 24 GB RAM (arm64)
environment.dataVolume: 500 documents (256 issue / 88 wiki / 35 sprint / 32 weekly_plan / 27 weekly_retro / 20 person / 15 weekly_review / 15 project / 7 standup / 5 program), 20 users — close to baseline's 500/20 target, minor distribution drift (256 vs 254 issue, 88 vs 91 wiki) from seed.ts/seed-augment.ts changes since 2026-07-27, not from tonight's 6 tickets
scaffolding: Ran against the machine's existing shared local PostgreSQL 16.14 (Docker container ship-postgres-1 on :5433), NOT the baseline's dedicated postgres:15-alpine ship-audit-pg container (that container no longer exists). MAJOR VERSION DIFFERS FROM BASELINE (15.13 -> 16.14) — a real, unavoidable environment change, orthogonal to tonight's 6 tickets.

Ran pnpm db:migrate + pnpm db:seed + audit/seed-augment.ts against the primary worktree's own dev database (ship_standup) to reach the required 500-doc/20-user volume; it was empty at the start of this run.

Patched audit/seed-augment.ts's workspace lookup from 'oldest workspace by created_at' to 'workspace named Ship Workspace' (matching api/src/db/seed.ts's own lookup) — the shared dev DB carried a leftover 'PF-107 Test' workspace from an unrelated OAuth-ticket test run that was older by created_at but had zero program/project/sprint documents, crashing the original query. Scaffolding-only change, no application source touched.
Installed autocannon@8.0.0 into the session scratchpad (not the repo).
Ran API server via `tsx src/index.ts` on :3001, NODE_ENV unset (dev mode) — matches baseline's server mode exactly.

gzip compression (TRO-174) is active in this run and was NOT active in the 2026-07-27 baseline (baseline explicitly recorded 'No response carries Content-Encoding'). This is a real, pre-existing fix that landed between the baseline and tonight, independent of the 6 W6 platform tickets — it materially lowers wire bytes and likely improves P95 on the large-payload endpoints (documents-all, issues) versus baseline. Flagged as a confound distinct from tonight's changes.

HEAVY CONCURRENT BACKGROUND LOAD during the first ~9 minutes of the 18-combination run: two sibling agents (an e2e Playwright regression suite using per-worker Postgres testcontainers, and a bundle-audit build) were active in this same repo/machine. Host load average peaked at 44 (14-core machine) during documents-wiki and issues measurements, confirmed via `docker stats` showing a testcontainers-ryuk reaper plus a dozen+ short-lived e2e worker containers. Load fell to ~4 (matching baseline's own reported 2.2-6.2 range) by the time team-assignments/weeks were measured.

Spot re-check performed: documents-wiki re-measured alone at all 3 concurrency levels once load had returned to ~4.1 (raw-recheck-documents-wiki/). Recheck P95 values (8.52 / 20.40 / 33.27 ms) closely match baseline (8.45 / 17.33 / 44.93 ms) — confirming the +306%..+749% deltas seen in the main run's documents-wiki rows were a background-load artifact, not a regression from tonight's middleware. The main run's documents-wiki rows are retained in the deliverable table for transparency but the recheck values are what should be trusted.

metrics.note: Full per-endpoint/concurrency P50/P95/P99/rps/errors table is in after-w6-r10-aug14.md. All 21 combinations (18 main run + 3 recheck) returned 0 errors / 0 non-2xx / 100% of the 900-request burst.

findings.title: documents-wiki P95 spiked +306% to +749% during the loaded portion of the main benchmark run — confirmed to be background contention from a concurrent e2e test suite, not a regression
findings.evidence: Main run (load avg 25-44): c10 P95=71.7ms, c25 P95=70.3ms, c50 P95=314.9ms vs baseline 8.45/17.33/44.93ms. Quiet-load recheck (load avg ~4.1, same endpoint, same methodology, ~20 min later): c10 P95=8.52ms, c25 P95=20.40ms, c50 P95=33.27ms — within noise of baseline. `docker stats` during the loaded window showed a testcontainers-ryuk reaper plus a dozen+ short-lived containers, consistent with the sibling e2e-test-runner agent's known per-worker-Postgres-testcontainer footprint (documented in audit/shipshape.config.yaml's testE2e entry).
findings.hypothesis: documents-wiki was the first endpoint measured in the run, landing during the sibling agents' peak Docker/CPU activity; by the time later endpoints (documents-all, team-assignments, weeks) were measured the load had subsided, which is also why those show P95 improvements over baseline rather than regressions.
findings.estimatedImpact: None on the W6-R10 gate once the confound is controlled for. No code or config change indicated.
